pairs: Interea locutus est Deus ad Jacob:
About this time, God said to Jacob,
facque altare Deo qui apparuit tibi quando fugiebas Esau fratrem tuum.
and make an altar to God, who appeared to you when you fled from your brother Esau.”
Jacob vero convocata omni domo sua,
In truth, Jacob, having called together all his house,
Abjicite deos alienos qui in medio vestri sunt, et mundamini,
“Cast away the foreign gods that are in your midst and be cleansed,
and let us go up to Bethel,
so that we may make an altar there to God,
qui exaudivit me in die tribulationis meæ,
who heeded me in the day of my tribulation,
and who accompanied me on my journey.”
Dederunt ergo ei omnes deos alienos quos habebant,
Therefore, they gave him all the foreign gods which they had,
et inaures quæ erant in auribus eorum:
and the earrings which were in their ears.
at ille infodit ea subter terebinthum,
And then he buried them under the terebinth tree,
which is beyond the city of Shechem.
And when they had set out,
terror Dei invasit omnes per circuitum civitates,
the terror of God invaded all the surrounding cities,
et non sunt ausi persequi recedentes.
and they dared not pursue them as they withdrew.
which is in the land of Canaan,
he and all the people with him.
And he built an altar there,
and he called the name of that place,
ibi enim apparuit ei Deus cum fugeret fratrem suum.
For there, God appeared to him when he fled from his brother.
Eodem tempore mortua est Debora nutrix Rebeccæ,
About the same time, Deborah, the nurse of Rebekah,
et sepulta est ad radices Bethel subter quercum:
died, and she was buried at the base of Bethel, under an oak tree.
And the name of that place was called,
Apparuit autem iterum Deus Jacob postquam reversus est de Mesopotamia Syriæ,
Then God appeared again to Jacob, after he returned from Mesopotamia of Syria,
“You will no longer be called Jacob,
for your name shall be Israel.”
and he said to him: “I am Almighty God:
gentes et populi nationum ex te erunt,
Tribes and peoples of nations will be from you,
and kings will go forth from your loins.
terramque quam dedi Abraham et Isaac,
And the land that I gave to Abraham and Isaac,
dabo tibi et semini tuo post te.
I will give to you, and to your offspring after you.”
Ille vero erexit titulum lapideum in loco quo locutus fuerat ei Deus:
In truth, he set up a monument of stone, in the place where God had spoken to him,
and he called the name of that place, ‘Bethel.’
venit verno tempore ad terram quæ ducit Ephratam:
he arrived in springtime at the land that leads to Ephrath.
And there, when Rachel was giving birth,
because it was a difficult birth,
she began to be in danger.
And the midwife said to her,
for you will have this son also.”
Then, when her life was departing because of the pain,
she called the name of her son Benoni,
the son of my pain. Yet truly,
his father called him Benjamin, that is,
the son of the right hand.
et sepulta est in via quæ ducit Ephratam,
and she was buried in the way that leads to Ephrath:
Erexitque Jacob titulum super sepulchrum ejus:
And Jacob erected a monument over her sepulcher.
This is the monument to Rachel’s tomb,
he pitched his tent beyond the Tower of the Flock.
And when he was living in that region,
et dormivit cum Bala concubina patris sui:
and he slept with Bilhah the concubine of his father,
which was not such a small matter as to be hidden from him.
Now the sons of Jacob were twelve.
These are the sons of Jacob,
qui nati sunt ei in Mesopotamia Syriæ.
who were born to him in Mesopotamia of Syria.
Venit etiam ad Isaac patrem suum in Mambre,
And then he went to his father Isaac in Mamre,
in qua peregrinatus est Abraham et Isaac.
Et completi sunt dies Isaac centum octoginta annorum.
And the days of Isaac were completed: one hundred and eighty years.
And being consumed by old age, he died.
et appositus est populo suo senex et plenus dierum:
And he was placed with his people, being old and full of days.
et sepelierunt eum Esau et Jacob filii sui.
And his sons, Esau and Jacob, buried him.
